_doc: Sim/view clip id -> KayKit library clip (REDESIGN_3D R2). The KayKit Character Animations
pack (CC0) ships 161 clips on the same Rig_Medium skeleton both cast members use, so the
everyday motion -- walking, idling, reaching, sitting, reacting -- is library animation and
nobody re-authors it. Only the gags the library has no equivalent for stay as our own 2D
clips, replayed on the 3D skeleton by PoseRetarget3D (listed under `overlay`).
A clip id absent from both lists falls back to the 2D overlay with a warning.

overlay._doc: Kept as our own 2D clips: the library has no sneeze, no freeze and no mime business.
